title: Order relations for the near geometric and near spectral geometric curves
summary: We investigate order and spectral properties of the weighted near geometric curve $A\star_tB=A^{1/2}(B^{1/2}A^{-1}B^{1/2})^tA^{1/2}$ on the cone of positive definite matrices. Our focus is on comparisons governed by the Loewner order, eigenvalue inequalities, and log-majorization. We establish a normalized eigenvalue comparison with the weighted arithmetic mean, give a sufficient condition for the corresponding Loewner inequality, and obtain conditional log-majorization relations.
